floater.name: fs_settings_tuner
floater.title: Suggest Settings
floater.string: Measuring... [SECONDS] s left. Stay in a typical place for you and keep the camera mostly still.
Log in and arrive in-world to measure.
No setting changes to suggest for this scene.
Tick the suggestions you want and press Apply selected. Select a row for its description.
Tick a suggestion first (or select one row).
Applied. Undo puts the previous values back. Press Measure again in the same place to see whether it helped: the summary then compares the frame time before and after.
The last applied changes are undone.

The main thread and the graphics card are both near their limit. This saves time on one side only, and the other side then holds the frame back, so on its own it gains little. Tick it together with a suggestion for the other side.
The report is on the clipboard.

scroll_list.name: suggestions
scroll_list.tool_tip: Suggestions from the measurement, the biggest saving first. Tick the ones to apply; hover over the change for what it does.

button.name: measure
button.label: Measure again
button.tool_tip: Measure this scene for about 20 seconds. Stay in a typical place and keep the camera mostly still.

button.name: apply
button.label: Apply selected
button.tool_tip: Change the ticked settings now (shader changes are made together, in one rebuild). The previous values are kept for Undo, also across a restart. If Preferences is open, closing it with Cancel puts settings shown there back.

button.name: undo
button.label: Undo
button.tool_tip: Put back the settings the last Apply changed

button.name: copy_report
button.label: Copy report
button.tool_tip: Copy the measurement and the suggestions to the clipboard, to paste where someone can help
